verdict.rationale: A state agency that runs online employer services such as EAMS quarterly tax and wage filing could plausibly publish an API spec, so the axis applies. However, no API documentation appears in the evidence, and probes of common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on esd.wa.gov all returned 404. The transactional host sits behind an authenticated login wall, and no spec was found anywhere.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
